title: Consider node name as well as executor name in allowedExecutors

timeline.body:
Closes #109792

Might be overkill, but it did seem safe enough to pattern match the thread-name here. A less hacky approach might be to create `EsThread extends Thread` which keeps a reference to the actual executor it belongs to so we could be more precise with these checks. But that seems like an impactful change that would require a lot more discussion.
I know some people have a visceral reaction to regexes and beyond a certain complexity I tend to agree, but this one seems simple enough.

timeline.body: Thanks for working on this. But I do think it's an overkill. The failure is test specific which does not happen in real node. Personally, I'd fix it by replacing the `threadpool.generic()` usage with a new test dedicated thread pool below this line https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/05f80ef058327c1a3d8a911b4872022cb3ff3210/server/src/internalClusterTest/java/org/elasticsearch/snapshots/SnapshotStressTestsIT.java#L223
